summary: Created “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1, installed it as a trusted RHEL system CA, and verified persistence after reboot. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Stored its private key root-only at /etc/pki/CA/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key.
Installed its certificate into the native RHEL trust store and regenerated the system bundle.
Verified the CA can issue a certificate trusted by the system.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed full recovery and trust persistence.

evidence.requirement: Create and install OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: Proves CA creation, secure permissions, requested identity, CA constraints, native anchor installation, and successful system trust verification.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Shows RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 before and after the change and reboot.

Captures the healthy baseline, native reboot acknowledgment, changed boot ID, recovered running state with zero failed units, persistent CA files and trust anchor, and successful post-restart issued-certificate verification.
